description: Cross-platform canonical market ID mapping system
steps: Create mappings/ directory at project root
Create mappings/market_links.yaml with initial structure (polymarket_market_id → canonical_market_id mappings)
Create src/prediction_data/gold/canonical.py with YAML loader and lookup class
Implement fallback: if no canonical mapping exists, use platform-native ID as canonical_market_id
Write unit tests for canonical resolution (mapped, unmapped, multi-platform)
Create ClickHouse DDL for dim_platform (ReplacingMergeTree, ORDER BY platform_id)
Populate with static data: polymarket, kalshi
Write loader in src/prediction_data/gold/dimensions.py
Add to Gold CLI: `prediction-data gold load-dims --table dim_platform`

description: Market dimension table from Silver markets with canonical IDs
steps: Create ClickHouse DDL for dim_market (ReplacingMergeTree(updated_at), ORDER BY (platform, platform_market_id))
Define schema: platform, platform_market_id, canonical_market_id, question, description, status, event_id, tokens (JSON), updated_at
Read Silver polymarket.markets via PyIceberg and transform to dim_market rows
Apply canonical ID resolution from market_links.yaml
Write to S3 Gold Parquet + load into ClickHouse
Scaffold Kalshi dim_market (DDL created, loader stubbed, no data)
Write integration test: Silver markets → dim_market round-trip

description: Outcome dimension derived from markets token data
steps: Create ClickHouse DDL for dim_outcome (ReplacingMergeTree(version), ORDER BY (platform, market_id, outcome_id))
Define schema: platform, market_id, outcome_id, token_id, side (token1/token2), outcome_label
Parse Silver markets 'tokens' field to extract token1/token2 per market as separate outcome rows
Write to S3 Gold Parquet + load into ClickHouse
Write unit tests for token parsing logic

description: Wallet dimension discovered from Silver trades
steps: Create ClickHouse DDL for dim_wallet (ReplacingMergeTree(last_seen_ts), ORDER BY wallet_address)
Define schema: wallet_address, platform, first_trade_ts, last_trade_ts, trade_count
Scan Silver polymarket.trades for distinct maker + taker addresses
Write to S3 Gold Parquet + load into ClickHouse
Design for incremental updates (new wallets discovered on each run)

description: CLI commands and testing for dimension loading
steps: Implement `prediction-data gold load-dims` CLI command (loads all dims, or --table for specific)
Add --dry-run support to dimension loading
Write integration tests for full dimension loading pipeline
Verify all dimension tables queryable in ClickHouse after loading
